summary_source: [지디넷코리아][부산=정진성 기자] 제48차 유네스코 세계유산위원회가 열리는 부산 벡스코 제1전시장 '대한민국관(K-Heritage House)'에 고대 왕국 백제의 숨결이 깨어났다. 백제세계유산센터는 이번 행사에서 '백제역사유적지구' 홍보 부스를 마련하고 전 세계 관람객을 맞이하고 있다.이곳 부스에서는 백제 후기인 475년부터 660년까지의 역사와 문화를 대표하는 8개 유적을 상세히 조명한다. 공주와 부여, 익산에 위치한 이들 유적은 백제가 웅진에서 사비로 도읍을 옮기며 발전시킨 정치·종교·문화적 중심지를 보여주는 연속유산이다.부스에서는 시기별로 다채로운 백제의 모습을 확인할 수 있었다. 웅진 시기 공주의 공산성과 무령왕릉 등을 통해 당시의 왕도 운영과 왕실 문화를, 사비 시기 부여의 부소산성과 정림사지, 나성 등에서는 사비도성의 중심 공간과 방어 체계를 엿볼 수 있었다.또한 사비 후기에 조성된 익산의 왕궁리유적과 미륵사지는 백제의 정치적 확장과 불교문화의 발전을 보여주는 대표 유적으로 꼽힌다. 이를 통해 백제 문화 특유의 세련된 미감과 우수한 건축 기술을 직관적으로 확인할 수 있다.특히 전시에서는 백제가 중국 남조 및 일본과 활발히 교류하며 완성한 독자…
title_ja: 大韓民国館ブースで輝いた「百済歴史遺跡地区」…古代東アジア交流照明
summary_ja: 第48回ユネスコ世界遺産委員会が開かれる釜山ベクスコ第1展示場「大韓民国館(K-Heritage House)」に古代王国百済の息吹が目覚めた。百済世界遺産センターは今回のイベントで「百済歴史遺跡地区」広報ブースを設け、全世界観覧客を迎えている。ここブースでは百済後期の475年から660年までの歴史と文化を代表する8つの遺跡を詳細に照明する。王女と扶余、益山に位置するこれらの遺跡は百済が熊津からサビに町を移し発展させた政治・宗教・文化的中心地を示す連続遺産である。ブースでは時期別に多彩な百済の姿を確認することができた。ウンジン時期姫の共産省と武霊王陵などを通じて当時の王道運営と王室文化を、私費時期付与の副所産性と整林寺地、ナソンなどではサビド城の中心空間と防御体系を垣間見ることができた。遺跡に挙げられる。これにより百済文化特有の洗練された美感と優れた建築技術を直感的に確認できる。 特に展示では百済が中国南条及び日本と活発に交流して完成した読者
title_en: ‘Baekje Historical Sites’ shines at the Republic of Korea Pavilion booth… Ancient East Asian Exchange Lighting
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] [Busan = Reporter Jeong Jin-seong] The breath of the ancient kingdom of Baekje has been awakened in the 'Korea Pavilion (K-Heritage House)', the first exhibition hall of BEXCO in Busan, where the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee is held. At this event, the Baekje World Heritage Center has set up a promotional booth for the 'Baekje Historic Site' and is welcoming visitors from all over the world. This booth highlights eight ruins representing the history and culture of the late Baekje period from 475 to 660 in detail. These ruins, located in Gongju, Buyeo, and Iksan, are serial heritage sites that show the political, religious, and cultural centers that Baekje developed as it moved its capital from Ungjin to Sabi. At the booth, you could see the various aspects of Baekje in each period. Through the Gongsanseong Fortress of Gongju and the tomb of King Muryeong during the Ungjin period, the operation of the royal capital and royal culture at the time could be seen, and at Busosanseong Fortress, Jeongnimsa Temple Site, and Naseong in Buyeo during the Sabi period, the central space and defense system of the Sabidoseong Fortress could be seen. In addition, the Wanggung-ri ruins and Mireuksaji site in Iksan, which were created in the late Sabi period, are considered representative relics that show the political expansion of Baekje and the development of Buddhist culture. Through this, you can intuitively see the sophisticated aesthetics and excellent architectural technology unique to Baekje culture. title_en: “The inspiration of a legacy that transcends time and space”... The Republic of Korea Pavilion’s ‘K-Heritage Immersive’ exhibition attracts attention.
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] [Busan = Reporter Jeong Jin-seong] Within the BEXCO exhibition hall in Busan, where the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee is being held, there is a place that attracts visitors with the most colorful light. This is the booth for the 2nd K-Heritage Immersive Exhibition 'Heritage: Timeless Time' planned by the National Heritage Promotion Agency. According to the initial performance count, the cumulative number of visitors was 11,160 in just 4 days of opening as of the 23rd, proving the enthusiastic response from the field. Using the 'courtyard' of a traditional Hanok as a motif, a symbolic space where people, time, and national heritage are naturally connected was created through large-scale media art. title_en: NVIDIA announces 'Model Express' to accelerate LLM distribution..."Reduces server waiting time from 8 minutes to 1 minute"
summary_en: As the size of large language models (LLMs) reaches terabytes (TB), the time to move model weights is emerging as a new bottleneck in AI services. To solve this problem, NVIDIA has unveiled a new model distribution infrastructure that utilizes direct GPU-to-GPU transfer technology. On the 24th (local time), NVIDIA announced ‘ModelExPress’, a software infrastructure that optimizes the distribution and expansion of LLM and the movement of model weights that occur during the reinforcement learning (RL) post-learning process. As the size of AI models grows to the level of terabytes (TB), the model is updated every time a new AI server is turned on.

title_en: Musk: “Advanced AI must be peer-evaluated by competitors for two weeks before deployment”
summary_en: CEO Elon Musk proposed a 'peer evaluation' method among major AI developers to efficiently manage the safety and security risks of cutting-edge AI models. The idea is that companies in the field are better suited to detect and verify risk factors in cutting-edge technology than government authorities who lack technological understanding. In an interview with The Economist on the 23rd (local time), CEO Musk said that competitors should have a system in place to review models for 1-2 weeks in advance before the cutting-edge AI system is released. He said, "I think if competitors have 1-2 weeks to review new products, they will be able to point out problems."
